defect.summary: Planner creation driver set step target_file to the literal string 'rust_ext/build_support/** (RP-01 allowed paths only)'. Daemon change-path whitelist is a literal ','/';'-separated exact-match list (rust_ext/src/daemon/task_collab_lifecycle.rs task.report handler), so no real changed file can ever match; first task.report fails E_CHANGE_PATH_NOT_ALLOWED.
defect.root_cause: planner-side creation payload bug (RP-01 card steps carry glob arrays; the creator wrote a prose literal instead of exact per-step file paths). No code defect: implementation commits 89860ded/89f83b3e are unaffected.

resolution: supersede the defective creation and recreate RP-01 with exact per-step target_file whitelists; append-only history preserved
